clauses.text: A person records wake phrase takes in a quiet room

steps.do: Following docs/development/WAKE-PHRASE.md, say the phrase 'My IYAKKI' about 50 times in a quiet room and save the WAV takes in the folder the doc names. Then run iyakki-wake-eval as the doc says.
steps.expect: The takes are saved as WAV files and the evaluation runs on them.
